items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Another time in Chicago we were playing the Birdland All Star, which featured Billy Eckstine, Sarah Vaughan, I think Chet Baker, Bud Powell, and a few others. The Basie band was the backup for all this.

ctx.x: We can’t have this in our band. You’re bringing us all down.

Yeah, we can’t have this, so Johnny Barracuda’s going to get that. Another time in Chicago we were playing the Birdland All Star, which featured Billy Eckstine, Sarah Vaughan, I think Chet Baker, Bud Powell, and a few others. The Basie band was the backup for all this. We were featured on the show. I had a feature on a song, a Neil Hefti song by the way, called Dinner With Friends, in which I had a

lengthy solo. This song usually opened the second half of the show after the intermission. When we arrived in town that day at the Chicago, at the Southway Hotel that I told you about before, an old south side landmark, I had prior to arriving called this young lady. I was still being a bad boy. I called this young lady and told her to meet me. When we arrived at the hotel, we were all checking in at the front desk.
